description: The Frobenius Gram G_ij = tr_M(b_i b_j) of the H_3 normal-form basis has signature (5,1) — Lorentzian, one negative direction, with a +/-0.855067 hyperbolic pair. The T4/T5 channel S = A*kappa*(ln^2 q0 - theta^2) has the same signature, and the corpus describes boost/spin structure in two other places. Controls whether the signature is constant in q (structural) or an accident at q0, then tests three declared readings of the per-anchor offset decomposed in the Lorentzian frame against the A_omega-free constraint curve. A signature match is a structural fact, not a determination of theta. Nothing fitted; nothing wired.

data.signature_note: (5,1) holds at every tested q in [1.05, 2.5], an interval containing q0 = 1.1102; it becomes (4,2) only near the classical limit q -> 1, with the transition (an eigenvalue crossing zero) at q_c = 1.0328057731. The initial all-points-identical test misdescribed this as a single-point coincidence; it is a stable region with a threshold below q0.

data.verdict: THE FROBENIUS GRAM OF H_3 AT q0 IS LORENTZIAN — signature (5, 1), exactly one negative direction, with a +/-0.855067 hyperbolic pair. THE SIGNATURE IS STABLE AROUND q0, NOT A SINGLE-POINT ACCIDENT: (5,1) holds at every tested q from 1.05 to 2.5, an interval containing q0 = 1.1102. It changes to (4,2) only near the classical limit, and the transition — where an eigenvalue of the Markov-trace Gram crosses ZERO — is at q_c = 1.0328057731. So this is a structural feature of the Hecke Gram with a genuine q threshold below the substrate point, not a coincidence. That matters because the T4/T5 channel S = A*kappa*(ln^2 q0 - theta^2) has exactly that signature, the T4 probe's own vocabulary is boost/spin-dominated, and CuspShapeBarParity independently puts q on a boost hyperbola — three places describing a Lorentzian structure the Gram supplies. NONE OF THE THREE DECLARED READINGS SUPPLIES theta: all fail the A-free curve's necessary straddling condition. The signature match is therefore a STRUCTURAL observation and NOT a determination of theta_K — precisely the distinction this arc keeps having to enforce. A SECOND, INDEPENDENT STRUCTURAL FACT: the unique timelike (negative-norm) direction is EXACTLY the bar-odd combination (L- - L+)/sqrt(2) of L+ = s0s1 and L- = s1s0 — every other component vanishes to 1e-9. CuspShapeBarParity independently states that the meridian is the bar-odd (boost) cycle, so two unrelated corpus objects agree on which direction is the boost. That is corroboration, not a fit — nothing was tuned to produce it. SCOPE (a): three readings of the Lorentzian decomposition were tested (signed Minkowski norm, timelike component, rapidity), all declared before evaluation. Untried and not excluded: the offset's components in the WEDDERBURN block basis rather than the eigenframe, and a reading built from the +/-0.855067 hyperbolic plane alone rather than the full 6-dim decomposition. Nothing fitted; nothing wired.
